buffer_reuse.design: One capacity-backed interleaved geometry per definition; contiguous texture groups; one presenter ShaderMaterial; one Mesh per node. Active-token ownership protects shared old generations before storage migration. Aggregate capacity pressure plus delayed shrink retires historical peaks.
buffer_reuse.verified: 200 changed inline generations build1 geometry/material/mesh. Source/opacity/geometry updates, same-count texture-only no vertex upload, growth/shrink/draw range, removal, shared generations/reused revisions/raw mutation and source dimension changes validated. 32 active resources taking turns peaking stay bounded without steady-frame churn.
buffer_reuse.default_edge_policy: GPU pixel-center coverage differs from Canvas AA only within tested one-pixel edge rims; tested interior tolerance2/255 and no shared-edge gaps.
buffer_reuse.snap_policy: Explicit snap uses physical-framebuffer transform then ties-away-from-zero rounding in vertex shader. Source UVs/unsnapped clip unchanged. GPU f32 precision around discontinuous half-pixel thresholds remains ordinary renderer precision; not an arbitrary-f64 exactness promise.

context_retirement.verified_owners: Sprite/custom shader, primitive box/sphere, decoded mesh, packed instancing, particles, heightfield and Bloom. Explicit owner hooks dispose GPU bindings while context is lost, retain CPU objects/arrays/images/cache entries, and avoid refetch.
context_retirement.negative_variant: Current official renderer response with ONLY retireWorldGpuBindings() call omitted by isolated QA server; reproduces prior behavior. Not a game modification or shipped SDK variant.
context_retirement.negative_warning: WebGL INVALID_OPERATION delete/deleteVertexArray: object does not belong to this context
context_retirement.limits: Ordinary engine-owned Three resources only. External presentation hooks and optional Effekseer restoration are outside this claim. Driver context loss frees old GPU storage; evidence proves stale CPU manager/listener ownership, not a measured live VRAM leak.
context_retirement.disabled_owner_contract_fix: Actual minimal official SDK export exposed missing contextLost on disabled particle stub. Exporter now emits explicit contextLost(_retire) no-op; actual export full/minimal closure test asserts the consumer/producer interface and all always-included owner hooks. Exact Rust stub behavior is executed by a Node regression. SDK candidate4 is preserved failed/unshipped; parent rebuilds candidate5.
